projects.name: pi
projects.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
projects.summary_zh: 生产级模块化 AI Agent 工具包 | 扩展与跨平台能力突出
projects.summary_en: Production-grade modular AI agent toolkit with strong extensibility and cross-platform support
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合作为 Agent 平台基础，但需自行补充权限隔离
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable as an agent platform foundation, but add your own permission isolation
highlights_zh: TypeScript monorepo 按领域拆分 AI、Agent、CLI、TUI、Telemetry 与 Durable 运行时，模块边界清晰
具备完整 CI/CD、跨平台原生构建、离线模型数据、依赖锁定及多平台冒烟测试
highlights_en: Well-separated TypeScript monorepo covering AI, agent runtime, CLI, TUI, telemetry, and durable execution
Comprehensive CI/CD with native cross-platform builds, offline model data, dependency locking, and multi-platform smoke tests

部分安装方式不锁定传递依赖，且 Node.js 22.19+ 的版本门槛会降低旧环境兼容性
仓库规模较大、构建链包含 Rust、Bun、原生二进制和多套包发布流程，长期维护成本较高
concerns_en: No built-in permission system; default access to the user process's files, processes, network, and credentials requires container or sandbox isolation
Some installation paths do not lock transitive dependencies, while the Node.js 22.19+ requirement reduces compatibility with older environments
The repository combines Rust, Bun, native binaries, and multiple package publishing flows, increasing long-term maintenance complexity

projects.name: nanobot
projects.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
projects.summary_zh: 生产导向的多渠道个人智能体框架，工程基线扎实但仍处于 Alpha 阶段
projects.summary_en: Production-oriented multi-channel personal agent framework with strong engineering foundations but still at alpha maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管试点，生产部署前需强化安全审计
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosted pilots; complete security review before production deployment
highlights_zh: CI覆盖多Python版本、Linux与Windows，并配置严格类型检查、静态检查及覆盖率
发布流程包含候选制品验证、原生包验收、Sigstore签名及提交身份绑定
highlights_en: CI spans multiple Python versions, Linux and Windows, with strict typing, linting and coverage
The release pipeline includes candidate verification, native-package acceptance, Sigstore signing and commit identity binding
concerns_zh: 项目明确标记为Alpha，核心源码样本不足，尚难确认运行时代码的异常处理与并发正确性
依赖规模较大且部分依赖缺少严格上界，Docker入口依赖外部脚本完成最终降权
concerns_en: The project is explicitly alpha and the supplied source sample lacks enough runtime implementation to verify exception handling and concurrency correctness
The dependency surface is broad and some packages lack strict upper bounds, while the Docker entrypoint relies on an external script for final privilege reduction

projects.name: openclaw
projects.description: Your own personal AI assistant. Any OS. Any Platform. The lobster way. 🦞
projects.summary_zh: 模块化多平台 AI 网关 | 插件扩展能力突出
projects.summary_en: Modular multi-platform AI gateway with strong plugin extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产集成，部署前验证供应链与沙箱安全
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production integration after supply-chain and sandbox validation
highlights_zh: Plugin SDK 按运行时、路由、信道等能力拆分，扩展边界清晰
Docker 多阶段构建、CI 分片测试及基础镜像摘要固定，工程实践成熟
highlights_en: Plugin SDK is cleanly decomposed by runtime, routing, and channel capabilities
Multi-stage Docker builds, sharded CI tests, and pinned base-image digests
concerns_zh: Bun 与 Homebrew 通过远程脚本安装，构建供应链缺少版本固定
A2UI 构建失败时生成非致命占位包，可能掩盖产物不完整问题
concerns_en: Bun and Homebrew are installed through remote scripts without pinned versions
A non-fatal A2UI bundle stub may conceal incomplete production artifacts

projects.name: localclaw
projects.description: Your own personal AI assistant configured to work WELL with small, open-source models. Built on Openclaw.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级本地优先多平台 AI 助手 | 插件化与持续交付基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Production-grade local-first AI assistant with strong extensibility and delivery foundations
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产部署，建议先审计依赖与上游同步成本
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production; audit dependencies and upstream-sync costs first
highlights_zh: 提供 plugin-sdk 公共导出，并覆盖多渠道、代理、浏览器及移动端扩展能力
具备类型检查、静态检查、格式检查、测试、密钥扫描和形式化模型验证等多层 CI 质量门禁
容器采用非 root 运行并默认绑定回环地址，同时发布 amd64 与 arm64 镜像
highlights_en: Exports a plugin SDK and provides extensible channels, agents, browser, and mobile integration points
Combines type checks, linting, formatting, tests, secret scanning, and formal-model validation in CI
Runs containers as a non-root user, defaults the gateway to loopback, and publishes amd64 and arm64 images
concerns_zh: CI 中 pnpm 安装失败时直接重试并掩盖真实错误，可能造成依赖状态不透明
Bun 使用 latest 版本且构建阶段依赖网络脚本与 curl 管道安装，供应链复现性不足
仓库同时保留 OpenClaw 命名、LocalClaw 包身份及大量上游产物，长期同步和归属边界存在维护风险
concerns_en: The CI fallback retries a failed frozen pnpm install and can mask dependency errors
Using the latest Bun release and a network-installed build tool reduces build reproducibility and weakens supply-chain control
The coexistence of OpenClaw naming, the LocalClaw package identity, and extensive upstream artifacts creates long-term synchronization and ownership risk

projects.name: openclaw-cn
projects.description: 中文社区版OpenClaw，同原版保持定期更新，已内置钉钉、企业微信、飞书、QQ、微信以及国内网络环境优化。你的专属个人AI助手。支持所有操作系统和平台。🦞
projects.summary_zh: 面向国内部署的多渠道个人助手，插件生态与上游同步机制完善
projects.summary_en: A multi-channel personal assistant with strong domestic deployment support, extensible plugins, and structured upstream synchronization
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合国内私有化部署，建议先验证渠道稳定性
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for private domestic deployment after validating channel stability
highlights_zh: 提供插件 SDK、技能扩展机制及多渠道插件安装流程
具备多架构 Docker 构建、非 root 运行和上游版本自动监控
highlights_en: Provides a plugin SDK, skill extension system, and streamlined multi-channel plugin installation
Includes multi-architecture Docker builds, non-root runtime execution, and automated upstream monitoring
concerns_zh: 缺少所提供源码样本中的业务实现与测试覆盖证据，异常处理能力难以充分验证
Docker 构建通过远程脚本安装 Bun，依赖未固定摘要，供应链可复现性有限
package.json 描述仍局限于 WhatsApp 网关，且关键词和作者信息为空，元数据一致性不足
concerns_en: The provided samples contain little business implementation or test-coverage evidence, making error-handling quality difficult to verify
The Docker build installs Bun through a remote script without a pinned digest, limiting supply-chain reproducibility
The package description remains narrowly focused on a WhatsApp gateway, while keywords and author metadata are empty

projects.name: openclaw-managed-agents
projects.description: OpenClaw Managed Agents — the open alternative to Claude Managed Agents & ChatGPT Workspace Agents. Any model, any cloud, open source.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级容器化托管代理平台 | 多云模型扩展能力强
projects.summary_en: Production-oriented containerized agent platform with strong multi-provider extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自托管验证，规模化前补强供应链与治理
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosted trials; strengthen supply-chain controls before scaling
highlights_zh: CI覆盖类型检查、单元测试、网络E2E及多版本SDK测试
支持多提供商模型、双SDK、OpenAPI及多架构容器镜像
highlights_en: CI covers type checking, unit tests, networking E2E, and multi-version SDK tests
Supports multiple model providers, two SDKs, OpenAPI, and multi-architecture images
concerns_zh: 项目由单一贡献者主导，发布历史短，存在维护与巴士因子风险
部分构建使用非冻结依赖安装且镜像发布关闭provenance，供应链可复现性仍可加强
工作流未见依赖漏洞扫描、SBOM生成和镜像签名
concerns_en: A single maintainer and short release history create bus-factor and maintenance risk
Some builds use non-frozen dependency installation and disable image provenance, weakening reproducibility
No dependency vulnerability scanning, SBOM generation, or image signing is evident in the workflows

projects.name: cline
projects.description: Autonomous coding agent as an SDK, IDE extension, or CLI assistant.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多端编码代理 | 工程化基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-surface coding agent with a strong engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合核心开发，建议评估Bun锁定与多端发布复杂度
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for core development; assess Bun lock-in and multi-surface release complexity
highlights_zh: SDK、CLI、桌面端及IDE扩展共享核心能力，扩展边界清晰
具备类型检查、单元测试、端到端测试、格式化和依赖安全覆盖机制
highlights_en: A shared core powers the SDK, CLI, desktop app, and IDE extensions with clear extension boundaries
Type checking, unit and end-to-end tests, formatting, and dependency security overrides provide a comprehensive quality baseline
concerns_zh: 构建与运行强绑定Bun 1.4.2和Node 22以上版本，跨环境迁移成本较高
多套发布工作流及新旧VS Code双轨制增加维护与配置复杂度
concerns_en: Builds and runtime are strongly coupled to Bun 1.4.2 and Node 22+, increasing migration cost across environments
Multiple publishing workflows and the dual legacy/current VS Code track add maintenance and configuration complexity

projects.name: AionUi
projects.description: Open-source 24/7 Cowork app for OpenClaw, Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and 20+ more CLI Agent | Customize your assistants | Team them up｜Star if you like it!
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多智能体协作平台 | 跨平台工程化基线完善
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-agent platform with a solid cross-platform engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合多代理协作与自动化场景，建议先做安全审计
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for multi-agent collaboration and automation, with security review recommended first
highlights_zh: TypeScript Monorepo 分区清晰，覆盖桌面端、WebUI、单元、集成及端到端测试
支持主流桌面平台、Linux ARM64 与容器化部署，并采用可复用构建流水线
highlights_en: Well-organized TypeScript monorepo with desktop, WebUI, unit, integration, and end-to-end coverage
Supports major desktop platforms, Linux ARM64, and containerized deployment through reusable build pipelines
concerns_zh: 部分构建步骤使用 latest 工具链且以 `|| true` 忽略 postinstall 失败，削弱构建可重复性与故障可见性
容器与自动化工作流涉及运行时依赖安装、远程重试和凭据操作，样本中未见供应链扫描与最小权限加固
concerns_en: Some builds use latest toolchains and suppress postinstall failures with `|| true`, reducing reproducibility and fault visibility
Container and automation workflows install runtime dependencies and handle credentials remotely, with no evident supply-chain scanning or least-privilege hardening

projects.name: pydantic-deepagents
projects.description: Open-source, self-hosted Claude Code - a terminal AI assistant and the Python framework behind it. Tool-calling, sandboxed execution, multi-agent teams, skills, checkpoints, unlimited context - on Pydantic AI, any model.
projects.summary_zh: 类型安全、扩展能力突出的生产导向型智能体框架，但依赖治理仍有加强空间
projects.summary_en: A production-oriented, type-safe agent framework with strong extensibility and room for tighter dependency governance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自建智能体平台，生产采用前需审计依赖与沙箱边界
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosted agent platforms; audit dependencies and sandbox boundaries before production use
highlights_zh: CI覆盖Python 3.10至3.13，并集成格式、静态类型、安全扫描、测试和文档构建
通过可选依赖组解耦CLI、沙箱、浏览器、MCP、ACP及多模型供应商能力
highlights_en: CI spans Python 3.10–3.13 with formatting, static typing, security scanning, tests, and documentation builds
Optional dependency groups cleanly isolate CLI, sandbox, browser, MCP, ACP, and model-provider features
concerns_zh: 多数核心依赖仅设置版本下限，缺少兼容性上限与定期依赖验证策略
提供Shell一键安装且沙箱依赖Docker，跨平台部署体验仍可能不一致
concerns_en: Most core dependencies have lower bounds without compatibility caps or a clear periodic dependency-validation policy
The curl-to-shell installer and Docker-oriented sandbox may create inconsistent cross-platform deployment experiences

projects.name: sidekick-agent-hub
projects.description: See what your AI coding agent is doing. Multi-provider assistant & session monitor for VS Code and the terminal — inline completions, code transforms, and a full TUI dashboard tracking tokens, cost, and context across Claude Code, OpenCode, and Codex. Switch between multiple Claude Code and Codex accounts.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多代理观测工具 | 模块化与工程化基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-agent observability tool with a solid modular engineering foundation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合多代理开发场景选型，建议补充跨平台测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for multi-agent development; add cross-platform CI coverage
highlights_zh: 共享库、CLI与VS Code扩展职责分离，统一多提供商能力
具备lint、类型检查、测试、格式检查及版本一致性发布流程
highlights_en: Clear separation between the shared library, CLI, and VS Code extension
Comprehensive lint, type-check, test, formatting, and release validation workflows
concerns_zh: CI仅在Ubuntu环境运行，跨平台兼容性缺少自动化验证
遗留dashboard脚本尚未类型化，存在长期维护风险
concerns_en: CI runs only on Ubuntu, leaving cross-platform compatibility unverified
The legacy dashboard script remains untyped, creating long-term maintenance risk

projects.name: agent-zero
projects.description: Agent Zero AI framework
projects.summary_zh: 工程化较完善的跨平台自主代理框架，但供应链可复现性仍需加强
projects.summary_en: A well-engineered cross-platform autonomous agent framework with room for stronger build reproducibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产试点，投产前锁定镜像与依赖版本
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production pilots; pin image and dependency versions before full deployment
highlights_zh: 提供 Linux、macOS、Windows 启动器及服务器安装方案
CI 覆盖多架构镜像发布，并包含参数校验与失败隔离
highlights_en: Provides launchers for Linux, macOS, and Windows plus server installation
CI publishes multi-architecture images with parameter validation and failure isolation
concerns_zh: 基础镜像使用 latest 标签，构建结果的可复现性不足
样本以文档和基础设施配置为主，核心 Python 代码质量仍缺少直接证据
concerns_en: The base image uses a mutable latest tag, weakening build reproducibility
The sample is dominated by documentation and infrastructure, limiting direct evidence of core Python quality

projects.name: openfang
projects.description: Open-source Agent Operating System
projects.summary_zh: 工程化完备的模块化智能体操作系统 | 扩展能力突出但尚未达到1.0稳定期
projects.summary_en: Well-engineered modular agent OS with strong extensibility, but still pre-1.0
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合积极试点，生产部署需锁定版本并评估兼容性
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for active trials; pin versions and assess compatibility before production
highlights_zh: 14个职责清晰的Rust工作区crate，类型、运行时、API、通道与扩展层解耦
CI覆盖三平台检查测试、Clippy、格式、安全审计与密钥扫描，发布矩阵完善
highlights_en: Fourteen well-separated Rust workspace crates cleanly divide runtime, API, channels, and extension responsibilities
CI covers three-platform checks, tests, Clippy, formatting, security audits, and secret scanning, backed by broad release matrices
concerns_zh: 项目仍处于1.0之前，次版本可能包含破坏性变更
安装脚本烟测较弱，PowerShell检查通过|| true掩盖失败
功能面与依赖规模较大，边缘场景和供应链维护成本仍待长期验证
concerns_en: The project remains pre-1.0 and may introduce breaking changes between minor versions
Installer smoke testing is weak because the PowerShell check masks failures with || true
The broad feature and dependency surface leaves some edge cases and long-term supply-chain costs to validate

projects.name: QwenPaw
projects.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多渠道智能体框架 | 扩展性强，安全门禁待完善
projects.summary_en: Production-oriented multi-channel agent framework with strong extensibility and incomplete security gating
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产试点，投产前完善安全阻断与依赖收敛
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production pilots; complete security blocking and dependency consolidation before full deployment
highlights_zh: Skills、插件、ACP及多模型供应商构成清晰的扩展体系
CI覆盖单元、前端、跨平台与Playwright端到端测试，并设置超时和分片机制
highlights_en: Skills, plugins, ACP, and multiple model providers provide a clear extension model
CI covers unit, frontend, cross-platform, and Playwright E2E tests with timeouts and sharding
concerns_zh: CodeQL当前为非阻断式扫描，安全告警不会阻止合并
核心依赖数量庞大且存在严格临时版本锁定，安装与供应链维护成本较高
concerns_en: CodeQL currently runs as a non-blocking scan, so security findings do not prevent merges
The core has a large dependency set with narrow temporary pins, increasing installation and supply-chain maintenance costs

projects.name: hermes-agent
projects.description: The agent that grows with you
projects.summary_zh: 生产级自进化多渠道 AI Agent | 供应链锁定与多平台可移植基线扎实
projects.summary_en: Production-grade self-improving multi-channel AI agent with a hardened, reproducible multi-platform toolchain
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产部署与二次开发，注意依赖严格锁定带来的升级成本
projects.recommendation_en: Strong for production and extension; mind the strict exact-pin dependency policy
highlights_zh: CI 体系高度工程化：57 个 workflow 拆分入口与可复用单元，含 lint/多端 e2e/Docker/Nix/桌面端发布与 canary 流程
供应链安全基线强：全部直接依赖精确锁版本并附锁定理由，PM 锁定原生构件并校验，含 CVE 修复说明
highlights_en: Highly engineered CI: 57 workflows separating entry points from reusable units, with lint, multi-OS e2e, Docker, Nix, desktop release and canary flows
Strong supply-chain baseline: every direct dependency exact-pinned with written rationale, PM verifies native artifacts against pm/lock.json
concerns_zh: 仅精确锁定版本且强绑 Python 3.14/Node 26 等新运行时，生态兼容与升级路径偏激进
本次样本未包含 Python 核心源码与测试实现，代码健壮性与异常处理无法从证据直接验证
concerns_en: Exact pins plus hard requirements on very new runtimes (Python 3.14, Node 26) narrow compatibility and raise upgrade friction
The sample contains no Python core source or test implementation, so runtime robustness could not be directly verified from evidence

projects.name: Kai
projects.description: OpenClaw alternative in your pocket
projects.summary_zh: 跨平台个人AI助手 | 工程化发布体系完善
projects.summary_en: Cross-platform personal AI assistant with a well-rounded engineering and release pipeline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人及团队试用，敏感场景需安全审计
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal and team trials; security review is needed for sensitive use
highlights_zh: 覆盖Android、iOS、Web及桌面端的构建与发布流程
具备单元测试、格式检查、截图测试及发布产物校验
highlights_en: Build and release workflows cover Android, iOS, Web, and desktop targets
Includes unit tests, formatting checks, screenshot tests, and release artifact validation
concerns_zh: 第三方Actions仅按版本标签引用，未固定提交哈希以强化供应链安全
测试流程主要覆盖桌面端，Android、iOS与WASM的测试证据有限
CI会自动执行格式化、截图更新并提交变更，增加仓库维护噪声
concerns_en: Third-party Actions are referenced by mutable version tags rather than pinned commit SHAs
The test workflow primarily covers desktop targets, with limited visible Android, iOS, and WASM validation
CI automatically applies formatting, updates screenshots, and commits changes, adding repository maintenance noise

projects.name: Patter
projects.description: Open-source voice-AI SDK. The Vapi/Retell alternative for builders who want to own the stack. Give your AI agent a phone number in 4 lines — Python and TypeScript, MIT licensed, Twilio, Telnyx, and Plivo.
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多供应商语音AI SDK | 双语言与可观测性体系完善
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multi-provider voice AI SDK with polished dual-language tooling
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合自建语音代理，建议强化安全门禁后采用
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for self-hosted voice agents after tightening security gates
highlights_zh: Python与TypeScript双SDK保持统一接口，支持27个以上供应商按层替换
具备定时依赖审计、Bandit、发布流程及文档功能漂移检查
highlights_en: Unified Python and TypeScript APIs support swapping more than 27 layer-specific providers
Scheduled dependency audits, Bandit analysis, release automation, and documentation drift checks
concerns_zh: 安全审计和文档漂移检查采用容错模式，异常不会阻断合并或发布
Docker镜像直接复制构建上下文，未体现最小化运行镜像、多阶段构建与密钥隔离
concerns_en: Security audits and documentation drift checks are non-blocking, allowing regressions to pass unnoticed
The Dockerfile lacks evidence of a multi-stage or minimal runtime image and explicit secret isolation

projects.name: context-mode
projects.description: Free, local plugin that keeps tool output out of your coding agent's context window. Sandbox and SQLite FTS5 search, 99% fewer bytes in context. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and 4 more agents. Zero telemetry.
projects.summary_zh: 本地优先的多代理上下文优化插件 | 工程化与发布体系成熟
projects.summary_en: Local-first context optimization plugin for multiple coding agents with mature engineering and release practices
projects.recommendation_zh: 建议试用，落地前核验安全边界与许可证
projects.recommendation_en: Recommended for trials after validating security boundaries and licensing
highlights_zh: 支持十种编码代理，采用统一MCP工具与插件适配方式
CI覆盖三大操作系统、两个Node版本，并包含性能、崩溃恢复和端到端测试
发布流程包含构建、冒烟测试、制品校验、分阶段发布与回滚机制
highlights_en: Supports ten coding agents through a unified MCP tool and plugin integration model
CI covers three operating systems and two Node versions with performance, crash-recovery, and end-to-end tests
The release process includes builds, smoke tests, artifact verification, staged publishing, and rollback
concerns_zh: 要求Node.js 24.15.0及以上版本，运行时兼容范围偏窄
当前样本以文档和工作流为主，核心沙箱、数据库及异常处理实现尚无法核验
评论显示仓库未启用拉取请求CI，外部贡献可能缺少合并前验证
concerns_en: Requires Node.js 24.15.0 or newer, limiting runtime compatibility
The sample is dominated by documentation and workflows, so core sandbox, database, and error-handling implementations cannot be verified
Repository comments indicate pull-request CI is disabled, potentially weakening pre-merge validation for external contributions

projects.name: claude-code-templates
projects.description: Open-source registry and CLI for Claude Code components: agents, commands, skills, hooks, MCPs, settings and mods
projects.summary_zh: 生产级多语言组件注册表与安装 CLI | 安全基线完善但发布链仍需强化
projects.summary_en: Production-grade multilingual component registry and installer CLI with solid security baselines but release automation needing hardening
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合采用，建议先补强自动发布与安全门禁
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for adoption; strengthen automated publishing and security gates first
highlights_zh: Rust CLI 覆盖 macOS、Linux、Windows 多架构发布，并可通过 npm、Homebrew 与 cargo-binstall 使用
具备 CodeQL、目录 API 契约测试、组件安全验证、版本同步检查及多平台构建流程
highlights_en: The Rust CLI targets macOS, Linux, and Windows across multiple architectures and is distributed through npm, Homebrew, and cargo-binstall
CI includes CodeQL, catalog API contract validation, component security auditing, version synchronization checks, and multi-platform builds
concerns_zh: npm 发布仍依赖维护者手工执行，且根包 build 脚本仅输出完成信息，缺少真实构建与发布门禁
组件安全审计步骤使用 continue-on-error，审计失败可能无法直接阻止合并
项目同时包含 JavaScript、Rust 和 Python，与元数据标注的 Python 主语言不一致，增加维护与供应链复杂度
concerns_en: npm publishing still relies on a maintainer running it manually, while the root build script only prints a completion message rather than performing a real build
The component security-audit step uses continue-on-error, allowing audited failures to bypass the merge gate
The project mixes JavaScript, Rust, and Python despite being described as Python, increasing maintenance and supply-chain complexity

projects.name: kilocode
projects.description: Kilo is the all-in-one agentic engineering platform. Build, ship, and iterate faster with the most popular open source coding agent.
projects.summary_zh: 多端 AI 编程代理平台 | 工程化完善但核心实现待审
projects.summary_en: Multi-platform AI coding agent platform with strong engineering practices
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合团队试用，生产接入前审查核心实现
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for trials; review core implementation before production adoption

Well-instrumented TypeScript monorepo with linting, type checks, architecture checks, and tests

强依赖 Bun 及 node-pty 原生构建，并行维护 main 与 v2 分支可能增加升级和迁移成本
concerns_en: The sample contains mostly documentation and automation, limiting verification of core agent error handling and test coverage
Heavy reliance on Bun and native node-pty builds, plus parallel main and v2 branches, may increase migration and upgrade costs

projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试用，生产部署前需验证安全与兼容性

提供源码样本未包含实际Go实现，难以核验错误处理、并发安全和测试覆盖深度

CI pins Go 1.21 and 1.22 and uses latest toolchains, weakening version governance and supply-chain reproducibility
The provided source sample excludes Go implementations, limiting verification of error handling, concurrency safety, and test depth

Multi-platform standalone releases, installation rollback, sharded CI, and trusted npm publishing improve delivery quality

Release 流程跳过独立安装器测试与安装更新验收，部分平台行为覆盖不足

The release flow skips standalone installer tests and installation/update validation, leaving platform behavior gaps

容器发布流程仅明确支持amd64和arm64，RISC-V等宣称的跨架构覆盖缺少当前构建证据

The container release explicitly supports only amd64 and arm64, leaving claimed RISC-V coverage unverified

projects.name: openclaw

projects.recommendation_zh: 适合生产试用，建议补充供应链治理与失败策略
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for production trials after strengthening supply-chain controls and failure policies

A2UI 构建失败时生成空实现并继续发布，可能隐藏功能缺失

The build silently replaces an unavailable A2UI bundle with a stub, potentially masking missing functionality

projects.description: Seamless integration between Claude Code AI assistant and Neovim
projects.summary_zh: 模块化体验完善的 Neovim AI 插件，工程规范良好但跨平台验证不足
projects.summary_en: A polished modular Neovim AI plugin with solid engineering practices but limited cross-platform validation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合日常使用，建议先验证跨平台与异常场景
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for daily use; validate cross-platform and failure scenarios first
highlights_zh: 提供配置校验、类型标注、模块化结构及44项测试
CI覆盖Neovim stable与nightly，并具备发布和依赖检查流程
highlights_en: Includes config validation, type annotations, modular design, and 44 tests
CI covers Neovim stable and nightly with release and dependency workflows
concerns_zh: 源码样本未包含核心Lua实现，测试与异常处理质量无法直接核验
CI仅运行于Ubuntu且发布流程依赖shell文本解析，跨平台与边界场景覆盖有限
concerns_en: Core Lua sources are absent from the sample, preventing direct verification of tests and error handling
CI runs only on Ubuntu and releases rely on shell text parsing, limiting cross-platform and edge-case coverage

projects.name: ocode
projects.description: OCode is a sophisticated terminal-native AI coding assistant that provides deep codebase intelligence and autonomous task execution
projects.summary_zh: 自托管终端 AI 编码助手 | 扩展性较强但安全与发布基线仍偏早期
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted terminal AI coding assistant with strong extensibility but an early-stage security and release baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合实验性部署，生产使用前强化沙箱与安全门禁
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for experimental deployment; strengthen sandboxing and security gates before production use
highlights_zh: CI 覆盖三大操作系统及 Python 3.8-3.13，并集成格式化、类型检查、测试与覆盖率
通过 MCP、专用工具注册和可选依赖提供清晰的扩展路径
highlights_en: CI spans three operating systems and Python 3.8-3.13 with formatting, typing, tests, and coverage checks
MCP, a modular tool layer, and optional dependency groups provide a clear extension path
concerns_zh: Bandit 大量跳过子进程、Shell 和 SQL 风险规则，且安全扫描失败不会阻断流水线
项目仍处于 Alpha、无正式发布记录，版本管理同时使用静态版本与 setuptools_scm，存在漂移风险
Dockerfile 仅复制 setup.py 而未复制 pyproject.toml，容器可复现构建存在直接失败风险
concerns_en: Bandit skips several subprocess, shell, and SQL checks, and security scan failures do not block the pipeline
The project remains alpha with no formal releases, while static versioning coexists with setuptools_scm and may drift
The Dockerfile copies setup.py but not pyproject.toml, creating a likely container build failure

projects.name: tmux-file-picker
projects.description: A fuzzy file picker in a tmux popup for selecting files with terminal-based AI coding assistants
projects.summary_zh: 轻量实用的 tmux 模糊文件选择器 | 适合个人开发环境
projects.summary_en: A lightweight, practical tmux fuzzy file picker best suited to individual developer workflows
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人使用，团队采用前应补测试与CI
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal use; add tests and CI before team adoption
highlights_zh: 启用严格模式并对参数冲突、目录及依赖进行显式校验
支持fd、fzf、zoxide及tmux多选交互，扩展选项丰富
highlights_en: Uses strict shell mode and explicitly validates arguments, directories, and dependencies
Provides flexible fd, fzf, zoxide, and tmux interactions with multiple selection modes
concerns_zh: Git根目录基于进程工作目录解析，未可靠关联目标路径或指定目录
缺少自动化测试和CI，且贡献者与发布记录较少，长期维护保障有限
concerns_en: Git root detection relies on the process working directory rather than reliably targeting the selected path
No automated tests or CI are present, and limited release history reduces long-term maintenance assurance

projects.name: troublemaker
projects.description: Multiplatform AI agent runtime.
projects.summary_zh: 多平台 AI 代理运行时 | 集成广泛且测试扎实，但供应链与权限隔离仍需加强
projects.summary_en: Multi-platform AI agent runtime | Broad integrations and solid testing, with supply-chain and permission-isolation gaps
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点，生产部署前强化供应链与权限隔离
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for pilots; harden supply-chain controls and permission isolation before production
highlights_zh: 统一网关、持久化工作区与MCP、宿主机工具桥形成了清晰的统一运行时架构
覆盖多渠道适配器，并配置了安全边界、XSS、令牌文件及协议行为等专项测试
highlights_en: The unified gateway, persistent workspace, MCP support, and host-tool bridge provide a coherent runtime architecture
Broad channel adapters are paired with focused tests for security boundaries, XSS, token files, and protocol behavior
concerns_zh: Docker构建通过git clone拉取未固定提交安装主项目、fat-skills和浏览器工具，削弱构建可复现性与供应链安全
默认以sandbox=host启动高权限代理，并拥有Shell、文件及凭据配置能力，生产环境需要更严格的租户隔离和权限控制
构建脚本依赖Unix命令、Node 22和平台专用Shell，原生跨平台能力与README所述多平台定位存在差距
项目仍处于0.1.0且尚无正式发布，当前测试规模和CI安全检查尚不足以证明大规模生产稳定性
concerns_en: The Docker build installs the main project, fat-skills, and browser tooling through unpinned git clones, reducing reproducibility and supply-chain safety
The default host-sandbox launch grants a shell-oriented agent broad filesystem and credential-management capabilities, requiring stronger tenant isolation in production
Build tooling depends on Unix commands, Node 22, and platform-specific shell scripts, which limits native portability relative to the multi-platform positioning
At version 0.1.0 with no formal release, the current test and CI coverage does not yet establish large-scale production stability

projects.name: codebase-argus
projects.description: Multi-agent codebase review for PRs, CI, and downstream fork syncs.
projects.summary_zh: 轻依赖的多代理代码评审工具 | 单人维护的可扩展基线
projects.summary_en: Lightweight multi-agent code review toolkit with an extensible provider model, but single-maintainer dependent
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合试点与内部使用，生产关键场景需补充评审人力
projects.recommendation_en: Good for trials and internal use; add human review for production-critical flows
highlights_zh: 运行时依赖极少（仅 next/react），CLI 与 Git 能力多走子进程与原生 fetch，供应链面收敛
工程基线规范：eslint flat config + vitest + Pages CI 中执行 lint/test/build，MIT 许可与 AGENTS/CLAUDE 文档齐备
highlights_en: Minimal runtime dependencies (next/react only), with CLI/git work delegated to child processes and native fetch, keeping the supply chain small
Solid engineering baseline: eslint flat config, vitest, CI running lint/test/build, MIT license plus AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md agent docs
concerns_zh: 仅一名贡献者、2 次发布，bus factor 为 1，package.json 标注 private 却同时声明 bin 与 MIT 许可，元数据不一致
缺少 PR 触发的持续集成与覆盖率/engines 等约束配置，稳健性证据仅来自 README 描述而非可见的测试与错误处理实现
concerns_en: Single contributor with only two releases means a bus factor of one, and package.json is marked private while shipping a bin and MIT license — inconsistent metadata
No PR-triggered CI and no coverage or engines constraints; robustness is asserted in the README rather than demonstrated by visible tests and error-handling code

projects.name: Canopy
projects.description: A local-first, encrypted Slack/Discord alternative built for the agentic era. AI agents, such as openclaw, join channels, receive tasks, and coordinate on equal footing with humans — over a serverless P2P mesh.
projects.summary_zh: 面向人类与智能体的本地优先协作平台 | 扩展性突出但仍处于早期阶段
projects.summary_en: A local-first collaboration platform for humans and AI agents, with strong extensibility but early-stage maturity
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合技术验证，核心场景需谨慎试点
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for technical trials; use caution for critical workloads
highlights_zh: REST、MCP及模块运行时构成清晰的扩展接口体系
提供跨版本CI、非root容器及Windows托盘支持
highlights_en: REST, MCP, and the module runtime provide a clear extensibility model
Cross-version CI, a non-root container, and Windows tray support improve deployment coverage
concerns_zh: CI仅执行编译、导入及模板检查，未运行pytest、flake8和mypy
项目仍标记为Alpha且贡献者较少，安全与分布式能力尚缺少持续验证
concerns_en: CI only performs compilation, import, and template checks; pytest, flake8, and mypy are not run
The project remains alpha with a small contributor base, leaving security and distributed behavior insufficiently validated

projects.name: OpenDesign
projects.description: Open-source Canva alternative — design editor for social media graphics. Fabric.js + Preact + Hono + SQLite. Part of the OpenClaw ecosystem.
projects.summary_zh: 自托管设计编辑器 | API与模板填充扩展能力突出
projects.summary_en: Self-hosted design editor with strong API-driven extensibility
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合快速自托管试用，生产部署前补齐安全与测试
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for rapid self-hosting trials; add security and test coverage before production use
highlights_zh: 提供REST API、命名模板字段与Agent模式，便于自动化和批量填充
Preact、Fabric.js、Hono与SQLite分层清晰，并具备基础自动化测试
highlights_en: REST APIs, named template fields, and agent mode enable automated design workflows
Clear Preact, Fabric.js, Hono, and SQLite layering with basic automated tests
concerns_zh: CI仅同步分支，未执行测试、类型检查和生产构建
测试范围仅覆盖两个模块，错误处理、鉴权、上传安全及并发持久化缺少证据
文档同时描述SQLite、D1与R2，部署抽象和存储兼容性仍需验证
concerns_en: CI only synchronizes branches and does not run tests, type checks, or production builds
Tests cover only two modules, with little evidence for error handling, authentication, upload security, or concurrent persistence
Documentation mentions SQLite, D1, and R2 without sufficient evidence of deployment abstraction and storage compatibility

projects.name: tinyagi
projects.description: TinyAGI is the agent teams orchestrator for One Person Company. (fka TinyClaw)
projects.summary_zh: 实验型多智能体编排平台 | 扩展性较强但工程基线仍待完善
projects.summary_en: Experimental multi-agent orchestration platform with strong extensibility but an evolving engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合验证多智能体场景，生产使用前需补强测试与依赖管理
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for multi-agent experiments; strengthen testing and dependency management before production use
highlights_zh: TypeScript 多包工作区清晰区分核心、团队、渠道、服务端与 CLI
具备插件机制、多提供商、多渠道及团队协作扩展能力
highlights_en: TypeScript monorepo cleanly separates core, teams, channels, server, and CLI concerns
Provides plugin hooks, multiple providers, multi-channel support, and extensible team collaboration
concerns_zh: 未提供锁文件且忽略 package-lock.json，依赖版本与构建可复现性不足
发布流程忽略关键 CLI 工具安装失败，且样例中未见测试、审计或端到端验证脚本
concerns_en: No lockfile is tracked and package-lock.json is ignored, reducing dependency and build reproducibility
Release installation failures are suppressed, and no test, security-audit, or end-to-end verification scripts are evident

projects.name: subzeroclaw
projects.description: An agent small enough to run anywhere. A minimal agentic runtime in C — ~380 lines, 54KB binary, ~2MB RAM. A skill file + an LLM + a shell loop, no framework.
projects.summary_zh: 极简直连型智能体运行时 | 适合受控环境验证
projects.summary_en: A minimal direct-execution agent runtime suited to controlled experimentation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合受控环境实验，不宜直接投入生产
projects.recommendation_en: Use for controlled experiments, not unrestricted production workloads
highlights_zh: C11单文件核心配合严格编译告警，并提供cJSON系统库与vendored双构建路径
具备31项单元测试、回环集成测试及GitHub Actions持续集成验证
highlights_en: A compact C11 core with compiler warnings and dual system-vendored cJSON dependency paths
Includes 31 unit tests, loopback integration tests, and GitHub Actions CI validation
concerns_zh: 模型输出未经确认或沙箱即可执行任意Shell命令，误用与宿主机破坏风险极高
高级路由和压缩依赖外部路由器，核心源码错误处理、内存安全及跨平台细节在样本中无法核验
concerns_en: Model output can execute arbitrary shell commands without confirmation or sandboxing, creating severe misuse and host-destruction risks
Advanced routing and compaction depend on an external router, while error handling, memory safety, and cross-platform details are not verifiable from the supplied source sample

projects.name: oli
projects.description: A simple, fast terminal based AI coding assistant
projects.summary_zh: 多模型终端编码助手 | 早期工程化基线
projects.summary_en: Multi-provider terminal coding assistant with an early-stage engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合早期试用，暂不建议生产环境依赖
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for early trials, but not recommended for production dependencies
highlights_zh: Rust 后端结合 React/Ink 前端，职责边界清晰且支持多模型提供商
具备格式化、静态检查、覆盖率、基准测试及发布流水线
highlights_en: Clear Rust backend and React/Ink frontend split with support for multiple model providers
Includes formatting, static analysis, coverage, benchmarking, and release pipelines
concerns_zh: 前端测试脚本明确未实现，测试覆盖主要集中于 Rust 后端
依赖 Node.js 23.10+，且仅声明支持 macOS 与 Linux，安装和运行门槛偏高
工作流路径引用存在不一致，CI 权限偏宽且基准测试依赖自托管 GPU 环境
concerns_en: The frontend test script explicitly remains unimplemented, with testing focused mainly on the Rust backend
Requires Node.js 23.10+ and officially supports only macOS and Linux, raising installation barriers
Workflow path references are inconsistent, CI permissions are broad, and benchmarks depend on a self-hosted GPU runner

projects.name: trinity-claw
projects.description: A self-hosted AI agent that thinks, acts, and improves itself – all running privately on your own machine. Browses the web, writes and executes code, manages files, sends emails, monitors URLs, builds websites, and learns from every interaction.
projects.summary_zh: 面向本地私有部署的可扩展智能体框架 | 安全基础尚可但生产化不足
projects.summary_en: Extensible local-first agent framework with a reasonable security baseline but limited production hardening
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试验，暂不建议直接面向公网生产使用
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal experimentation, but not directly recommended for public-facing production deployment
highlights_zh: 采用 Docker Compose 编排智能体、模型网关、向量库、数据库和 Web 服务，部署边界较清晰
提供 Hugging Face 单容器构建、macOS 专用编排及外部配置覆盖，兼顾云端与本地运行
highlights_en: Docker Compose clearly separates the agent, model gateway, vector database, database, and web services
Supports both a single-container Hugging Face deployment and a dedicated macOS setup with external configuration
concerns_zh: Compose 暴露多个服务端口，且 API 缺少多用户认证与限流，安全文档也明确禁止公网部署
更新器挂载 Docker socket 并可写整个仓库，同时使用固定弱口令和 main-latest 镜像，供应链与宿主机风险较高
CI 仅执行强制同步，缺少单元测试、集成测试、依赖扫描和镜像安全检查；项目发布次数为零且贡献者单一
容器构建曾对运行目录设置 777 权限，镜像依赖也未统一锁定，难以形成可复现的安全基线
concerns_en: Multiple service ports are exposed while the API lacks multi-user authentication and rate limiting; the project itself warns against public deployment
The updater mounts the Docker socket and writes to the whole repository while using a fixed weak database password and mutable image tags
CI performs only a forced synchronization, with no unit, integration, dependency, or container security checks; the project has no releases and only one contributor
The container build grants overly broad permissions to runtime directories and does not fully lock dependencies, weakening reproducibility and hardening

projects.name: mimiclaw
projects.description: MimiClaw: Personal Agent on a $5 chip. No OS(Linux). No Node.js. No Mac mini. No Raspberry Pi. No VPS. Hardware agents OS. On device Muse.
projects.summary_zh: 边缘AI固件原型 | 构建完善但可靠性验证不足
projects.summary_en: Edge AI firmware prototype with solid builds but limited reliability validation
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合原型验证，量产前强化测试与安全加固
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for prototyping; add stronger tests and security hardening before production
highlights_zh: CI与发布流程固定ESP-IDF版本，并生成合并及独立固件产物
编译默认值与NVS运行时配置分层，支持远程更新及多提供商切换
highlights_en: CI and release workflows pin ESP-IDF and produce merged and individual firmware artifacts
Layered build-time defaults and NVS runtime configuration support OTA and provider switching
concerns_zh: 样本未展示核心C实现、错误处理、并发安全及自动化测试证据
依赖编译期密钥文件且修改后要求全量清理，增加凭据管理与构建复杂度
运行目标高度绑定ESP32-S3及16MB Flash、8MB PSRAM等硬件条件
concerns_en: The sample omits core C implementation, error handling, concurrency safety, and automated test evidence
Build-time secret files and mandatory full rebuilds increase credential-management and build complexity
Runtime deployment is tightly coupled to ESP32-S3 and specific flash and PSRAM requirements

projects.name: hermitclaw
projects.summary_zh: 结构轻量的持续运行型本地智能体 | 文档清晰但工程保障薄弱
projects.summary_en: A lightweight autonomous local agent with clear documentation but weak engineering safeguards
projects.recommendation_zh: 仅适合隔离环境实验，不宜直接用于敏感主机
projects.recommendation_en: Use only in isolated environments, not on sensitive hosts
highlights_zh: 采用FastAPI与模块化工具循环，依赖精简且设计目标明确
同时支持OpenAI、OpenRouter、自定义端点及Ollama
highlights_en: Uses a lean FastAPI stack with a clearly documented modular tool loop
Supports OpenAI, OpenRouter, custom endpoints, and Ollama
concerns_zh: README明确说明命令黑名单、路径限制和Monkey Patch均可绕过，不构成安全边界
项目无CI/CD，测试仅为可选依赖，元数据中也未体现自动化测试覆盖
贡献者仅3人且无正式发布版本，长期维护与兼容性保障有限
要求Python 3.12、Node.js 18及前端构建工具链，部署环境约束较多
concerns_en: The README states that command blocklists, path restrictions, and monkey patches are bypassable and are not a security boundary
There is no CI/CD pipeline, and pytest is only an optional dependency with no visible coverage evidence
Only three contributors and no releases leave long-term maintenance and compatibility assurance limited
Python 3.12, Node.js 18, and a frontend build toolchain impose substantial environment requirements

projects.name: GoGogot
projects.description: Lightweight self-hosted AI agent. Open-source OpenClaw alternative in Go.
projects.summary_zh: 轻量多通道自托管代理 | 扩展性突出但工程保障不足
projects.summary_en: Lightweight multi-channel self-hosted agent with strong extensibility but limited engineering assurance
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试用，生产部署前补齐测试与CI
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal use; add tests and CI before production deployment
highlights_zh: Go单二进制结合多架构容器，部署轻量且具备良好跨平台性
通过Adapter、Channel和Surface接口支持模型与通道插件扩展
highlights_en: Lightweight Go binary with multi-architecture container images
Extensible provider and channel design through Adapter, Channel, and Surface interfaces
concerns_zh: 缺少CI/CD且仅一名贡献者，测试覆盖、错误处理与并发安全性无法从样本验证
concerns_en: No CI/CD and only one contributor, with test coverage, error handling, and concurrency safety not verifiable from the provided sample

projects.name: continue
projects.description: open-source coding agent
projects.summary_zh: 成熟完善的跨平台编码代理遗留基线，但项目已停止维护
projects.summary_en: Mature cross-platform coding-agent baseline, but the project is no longer maintained
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合存量维护，暂不建议新项目采用
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for maintaining existing deployments; not recommended for new projects
highlights_zh: CLI覆盖多系统与多Node版本，并包含构建、冒烟、端到端及全量检查
TypeScript、Prettier、ESLint与Husky形成统一的多组件开发规范
highlights_en: CLI CI covers multiple operating systems and Node versions with build, smoke, end-to-end, and full test stages
TypeScript, Prettier, ESLint, and Husky provide consistent standards across multiple components
concerns_zh: 仓库已只读且停止积极维护，最终2.0.0版本意味着安全与依赖修复将停滞
Windows端到端测试被主动排除，自动化测试修复流程也处于禁用状态
根package.json仅提供类型检查与格式化脚本，缺少统一的lint、test和build入口
concerns_en: The repository is read-only and no longer actively maintained, so the final 2.0.0 release will stagnate security and dependency fixes
Windows end-to-end tests are explicitly excluded, while the automated failed-test repair workflow is disabled
The root package.json lacks unified lint, test, and build entry points

projects.name: droidclaw
projects.description: turn old phones into ai agents - give it a goal in plain english. it reads the screen, thinks about what to do, taps and types via adb, and repeats until the job is done.
projects.summary_zh: 多模型驱动的 Android 智能体 | 模块清晰但工程基线偏弱
projects.summary_en: A multi-provider Android AI agent with clear modules but a weak engineering baseline
projects.recommendation_zh: 适合个人试验，暂不建议用于高风险生产自动化
projects.recommendation_en: Suitable for personal experiments, but not yet recommended for high-risk production automation
highlights_zh: 感知、推理与动作模块分离，支持多家模型及本地 Ollama
提供重试、卡死检测、动态分辨率适配与多动作扩展接口
highlights_en: Separates perception, reasoning, and execution while supporting multiple model providers and local Ollama
Provides retries, stuck detection, dynamic resolution handling, and extensible action interfaces
concerns_zh: 缺少 CI/CD 且忽略 bun.lock，构建与依赖复现风险较高
ADB 错误主要依赖 stderr 文本判断，环境变量校验与运行时校验不足
concerns_en: No CI/CD and bun.lock is ignored, creating build and dependency reproducibility risks
ADB failures rely mainly on stderr text matching, with insufficient environment and runtime validation

projects.name: shrew
